name: hound-facetank-solo
description: ACCEPTANCE, facetank: adversarial's h3 deck-facetank policy (hold right + fire, one 16ms jump at 1400ms to thread column 39, then never leave the deck) replayed against stage 1's reworked chokepoint placements. The question is whether i-frames make the telegraph decoration for a player willing to eat hits: 1200ms of i-frames vs a ~100ms charge sweep means one pass costs exactly one point, and the two chokepoints of a pass cost two of three. Reported as a damage count, not a pass/fail on completion — eating the hound is allowed to be a choice, it just has to cost.
